svg.title: Malferma Libro — a free ebook reader for Linux
svg.desc: The official gold and navy emblem beside an authentic screenshot of the reader displaying Lesya Ukrainka's Ukrainian poem Надія. EPUB, FB2, PDF and OPDS catalogs are highlighted.
svg.metadata: Promotional composition, GPL-3.0-or-later. Official emblem and original screenshot retain their existing notices. Background generated with OpenAI image generation; composition prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. See README.md in this directory for sources and licensing.
